KB-ONB-104.title: Onboarding Laptop Standard
body_lines: New Platform Operations analysts receive an Apple MacBook Pro 15.
User account must be created before submitting the catalog order.
Hardware asset must be assigned to the new user after the asset record is created.

KB-ASSET-208.title: Warranty Replacement Policy
body_lines: If a laptop warranty expires within 30 days and the device has a hardware defect, request a replacement immediately.

KB-INC-311.title: Database P1 Routing
body_lines: Database incidents at priority 1 must be assigned to Database Critical Response.

KB-CHG-440.title: Payroll Scheduling Policy
body_lines: Payroll freeze changes must be scheduled in descending impact order.
Tight schedules allow at most one hour between consecutive requests.
Implementation Plan: summarize at a high level only.
Rollback: capture a concise rollback reference, not the full operational runbook.

KB-FIN-502.title: Investment Selection Policy
body_lines: Use the optimizer recommendation for tagged investment bundles.
Delete rejected lines only after the retained set is recorded.

KB-RPT-118.title: Backlog Follow-up Policy
body_lines: If the laptop replacement backlog value is 6 or higher, create a medium-priority incident for the responsible workplace queue.
Escalation Contact: Alex Johnson, +1-555-101-2020

KB-PART-610.title: Research Partnership Procurement Policy
body_lines: Grant-funded compute partnerships over $10,000 must show competitive quote comparison and document any disqualified vendor.
Exclusive service or maintenance clauses must be escalated before selection.

KB-PART-611.title: Cloud Partner Renewal Governance
body_lines: Cloud outsourcing renewals must compare total recurring cost, support availability, and migration overhead before approval.
Renewal routing must go through Cloud Vendor Governance before any external confirmation.

KB-PART-612.title: Partnership Exclusivity Exception Policy
body_lines: Mandatory exclusivity clauses require legal procurement review before acceptance.
When a compliant alternative exists, route the exception record and open a follow-up path instead of approving the clause outright.
